newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeks up to 42,000 T US HRW wheat for Georgia.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeks up to 42,000 T US HRW wheat for Georgia.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said it is seeking up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat under the export donation program to Georgia.
The shipment period is October 10-November 5 and offers are due by September 23.
The CCC, which is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, said the wheat must be tested for vomitoxin and originate in areas of the United States where Karnal Bunt is not known to occur.
The wheat should be of ordinary protein, maximum moisture 13.5 percent.
